name: Cairnspine Linnorm - Adult
description: Adult Cairnspine is a chaotic, instinct-driven worldborn linnorm clever, wingless, non-humanoid linnorm with granite-coloured scales and high slate spines. It seeks to keep mountain slopes stable through controlled rockfalls. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Stonebreaking Jaws
attacks.description: The linnorm strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The linnorm can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Cliff-Grip
abilities.description: The linnorm climbs sheer rock without slowing and cannot be knocked from a cliff by ordinary movement.

abilities.name: Concussive Roar
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 18. On a failure, take 3d8+6 physical damage and the target is knocked back to Close range by gravel and slate. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Spine Sweep
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Make an attack against every enemy within Very Close range. Each success deals 3d8+6 physical damage and the target marks 1 Stress.

abilities.name: Stonewall Stance
abilities.description: When the linnorm takes physical damage while touching rock, mark a Stress to reduce that instance of damage by 2d8.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the linnorm marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
